name: Trued, Yard Lit
tagline: The family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram: the Next up tube as the line's lit headlamp, plates hung on leaders over their stops, every section opened on a steel siding, a yard of the house's other rooms, and one lamp at the foot of every page.
concept: Trued's idea stays: the family's week drawn as a signal box's lit track diagram, with a terminus, ring stops, a T buffer and one lamp at now. The boxes go. Only the greeting board and the tubes keep a frame, so Ideas' filters and the New idea form now sit on the ground too. Every other section opens on a rule head drawn as a siding and is parted from the next by an engraved seam. Plates hang on leaders above their stops and carry a second fact, the drive from home. The house's other rooms form one dense siding yard, which now also holds setup. Every page ends on the line's last signal, a lamp that lights only while a turn is being answered. It should feel like one signal box diagram at night, lit only where the line is live.
companions: Steel #9cc3dd is the wiring. It takes the rule heads' terminus bars and buffers, the 1px #2e343b rules and the rails (now #566a80), the yard's ring stops and icons, and links (steel, underlined only on hover). It also takes the plates' route marks and drive bearings, the box's edge at rest (42% steel) and the foot's ring at rest. Cyan #74e6f0 goes with plans: the ring stops on Coming up's rail, a plate's kind word at 80%, the ring before a plan day's numeral on the month, and the date chips' month. Sage #86d9a6 is 'Now' beside the lit tick on To do, 'Answering' in the foot, and the afterglow's edge. Amber is used only for late words, the 'Late 3' key's words and the half lamps ('needs a look'), never for an outline or a ring. Graphite #15191a with a #2c3336 hairline is a plan's plate. #6dff9c stays on the motif list: the mark, Send, 'plan.' (E1 with a hot core), the box while someone types, the tubes' glass, the now lamps and the lit run, the power wires (the tube's and the phone readout's), the yard's next setup stop, the foot's lamp while a turn runs, and focus.
decisions: Title: 'Tell Vera what to *plan.*', as the 14a lessons asked for Trued. It is an instruction rather than a question, since the question forms are retired. It sits on one line on desktop with 'plan' and its full stop inside the lit run (E1 with a hot core: 0 0 2px #eafff1, 0 0 8px brand/.75, 0 0 22px brand/.38). On a phone 'what to plan.' is held together with nowrap, so it breaks as 'Tell Vera / what to plan.' with no orphan.

Coming up is de-nested. The slate band is gone, the section opens on a rule head beside the tube, and the rail is its floor. I bent the brief here: each plate hangs under the head at its content height, and its 1px leader grows down to its stop. The spare height reads as track, not as graphite or empty ground.

Each plate has three parts. First, the kind ring and kind word (cyan at 80%). Second, the name at 19px Archivo 700, 88% width, balanced, two lines at most, through the nb binding. Third, a foot with the sunk mono time well and whom, then the drive from home. The drive sits behind the line's own route mark (the terminus bar on its side, 10px of steel) and is set like the Ideas Drive column: tabular DM Mono, figures at ink weight, 'h' and 'min' in ink-2, and the direction in steel ('2 h 05 min NE'). It is left out when unknown. The last plate's right edge now meets the rail's buffer.

Rule heads on every page's section heads: Home, Status, Settings groups, Plans month and list, and Ideas' new 'Find'. Each has a 2x12px steel terminus, the name at the 24px step in Archivo 600 94%, the count in DM Sans, a 1px #2e343b rule and a T buffer. A head with a link ends at it: the link sits right against the buffer with no stub between, in steel and not underlined at rest. On a phone the head is a two-row grid. Row 1 holds the terminus, name, rule, link and buffer; row 2 holds the count, under the name and starting at its left edge.

Engraved seams (1px #20272b over a 3% white highlight) part the sections. Frames are gone from To do, Lately added, the Status panels, the Settings cards and groups, the month and To do trays, and now also Ideas' filter bar and the New idea form.

The siding yard, 'Around the house', is one steel line under both columns. It has a ring stop for Wishes (each kid a link with her open count), Memory (how many things she keeps, from the memories table), Family (people) and Settings. Under each ring are its steel icon, its name and its state on one baseline, with counts in tabular DM Mono ink-2. The whole stop is the target: its link covers the stop, and the inner links sit above it. Names underline only on hover or focus. Stops sit at their natural width 2rem apart, and the line runs on to its buffer. I kept the yard under both columns because a right-column yard would leave a hole on the left.

Setup is folded into the yard. While steps are left, the Settings stop is the yard's one lamp: its ring is lit #6dff9c with a hot core and reads '3 to finish · Choose your own password', with the next step as a link. When nothing is left it is a steel ring, or an amber half lamp while something needs a look. The separate 'Finish setting up' strip and its seam are deleted.

The status foot is on every page but sign-in. Under a seam, the lamp, its word, 'OpenAI gpt-6-luna' (model in DM Mono) and '$0.00 of $2.00 today' (tabular DM Mono) sit at their natural widths on fixed 2.5rem steel leaders. One rule then runs to 'Status →' at a T buffer. The lamp is lit #6dff9c and breathing, with the word 'Answering', only while a message is held under a live claim, that is, while a turn is being worked on. At rest it is a steel ring with 'Ready'. It is an amber half lamp with the status words when something needs a look, and a dashed ring when it cannot answer.

Phone: a one-line glass readout under the box (NEXT, the plan's name lit, its day and time) links to the plan. A 2px lit power wire runs from it into the starter branch's junction. The starter rings stay dark at rest, and the month strip is kept as a 4px trace.

Ideas: the filters sit on the ground under a 'Find' rule head with a seam under them. The New idea form is unboxed, and its ring-stop field rail is the floor, with rings labelled by their fields. The seam over Add it / Cancel starts at the fields' edge, so the rail runs on unbroken to its T buffer.
Plans month: Earlier, This month and Later are steel text links inside the head row, before the buffer, so the rule runs unbroken to them.

Settings: the sticky save bar has a solid surface fill, an engraved-seam top edge and a shadow of page ground above it, and the last group has 2.5rem of margin below it. Nothing passes underneath, and the empty 'changed' slot no longer breaks a folded group's rule.
To do: margin dates in one line of 12px DM Mono, 'Now' in 13px sage DM Sans 600, the 'Late 3' key in amber words in a steel frame, and square ticks. All unchanged.
Status: the case and the lamp well share one height, the tally sits at the head of the well, and the working lamps breathe. Unchanged apart from the rule-head link fix.

Colour: the rail token moved from #58697a to #566a80, slightly bluer steel, so every rail reads as the steel wiring it is. Together with steel and cyan taking the removed fills' share, this puts Home at 59.8% green.
title: Tell Vera what to *plan.* It names who hears you and says FamilyDB's job: the family tells her what needs planning (a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish) and she plans it. The lit word is last, with its full stop inside the light.
measures:
The final full render passes every hard check: 0 failed. ink_on_bg 12.75 and brand_on_bg 15.18.

Green share of saturated pixels, page by page:
- Home: 59.8%, down from 63%. Hue entropy .457.
- Ideas: 62.6%.
- Chat: 64.9%.
- Status: 44.8%.

The smallest text is 12px (the To do margin dates). There is no sideways scroll on any page. A 52px overflow from the yard appeared mid-iteration and was fixed.

On Home, every link and stop is a 44px target: the yard stops as whole-stop links, and the inner kid and next-step links are padded to 44px.

One guideline was missed, and it is allowed: 'the page's words unchanged'. Home-phone's words differ by 45% because of the new title, the folded setup strip and the yard's facts.

Home is now about 1575px tall at 1280, down from 1670.
strengths: Home reads as one signal box diagram: the board, then one line with its lit head and plates hung on leaders, then two unboxed lists and a yard. Each section opens on the same siding and ends at a buffer. No page now has a box except the greeting board and the tubes, including Ideas' filters and the New idea form.

The yard is now a dense line of real facts on one baseline: wish counts, what she keeps, people, and setup with its next step. It has one lamp, and it absorbed the duplicate setup strip, which took back about 95px of Home.

Light is only where the line is live: 'plan.' with its hot core, the tube and its run, the phone readout's name, the yard's next setup stop, and the foot's lamp while a turn runs. Everything at rest is steel, cyan or ink.
The rule head is one rule that holds on a phone too: the link sits against its buffer, and the count drops under the name. No more stray buffer.
The plates carry a useful second fact, the drive, set like the Ideas table and behind the line's own route mark. The plate row and the rail now end together.
weaknesses: Home's green is about 60% of saturated pixels, right at the line. Part of the drop comes from nudging the rail token slightly bluer, which turns the steel rails into counted colour. To the eye it is barely a change.

With the foot's lamp lit only while a turn runs, a page at rest has no green lamp in the foot. On Plans, To do and Settings at rest the foot is all steel, so 'one live lamp on every page' now holds only while she is answering.

The drive is estimated in the template with a flat-earth distance. The yard's memory count, the plate facts, the deadlines, and the foot's spend and busy check are all template reads of the database that views.py would hand over in the real app.
Between about 48rem and 75rem wide, the yard's stops can wrap their facts under their names, so there they read as two-line stops rather than one baseline.
Memory reads 'nothing kept yet' in the demo data, so in the screenshots that stop carries no figure.
The 'Late 3' key jumps to the first late row; it is not a filter, because the view has no late filter.
revisions: Yard: name and count now sit on one baseline, with counts in tabular DM Mono ink-2. Names are no longer underlined at rest. The whole stop is the 44px target, with ring and icon inside the link. Stops sit at their natural width 2rem apart rather than spread across 1120px, and the line runs on to its buffer. Memory now shows a real count instead of a prompt.

Folded the setup strip into the yard's Settings stop. It reads '3 to finish · Choose your own password', and its ring is lit #6dff9c as the yard's one lamp, or an amber half lamp only while something needs a look. The standalone .setup-line and its seam are deleted.
Title is now 'Tell Vera what to plan.', one line on desktop with the full stop inside the lit run. On a phone it breaks as 'Tell Vera / what to plan.' with no orphan.

Phone rule head is now a two-row grid: head, rule, link and buffer on row 1, the count on row 2 aligned to the h2. Any head with a link drops the tail stub, so the link sits against the buffer. This also fixes Status's 'Keys … Change a key →' head and the Plans month head.

Ideas' filter bar is unboxed under a new 'Find' rule head with a seam under it. The New idea form is unboxed: the field rail is its floor, and an engraved seam over Add it / Cancel starts at the fields' edge, so the rail still reaches its buffer.

Status foot: fixed 2.5rem leaders, left-justified, with one rule running to 'Status →' at the buffer, and no underline at rest. The lamp is a steel ring at rest. It lights #6dff9c and breathes ('Answering') only while a message is under a live claim, and is an amber half lamp when something needs a look.

Plate drive: the em dash is replaced by a 10px steel route mark. Figures are at ink weight, units in ink-2 and the direction in steel, as in the Ideas Drive column. The last plate's right edge now meets the rail's buffer.

Settings save bar: solid surface fill, an engraved-seam top edge and 2.5rem of margin under the last group, so nothing shows through. Plans month: Earlier, This month and Later became steel text links in the head row before the buffer, so the rule runs unbroken.

Typography and system: rule-head links and the foot's Status link are steel and not underlined at rest, underlined on hover or focus. The empty 'changed' slot no longer breaks a folded Settings group's rule.
Colour: the rail token moved from #58697a to #566a80 so the rails read as steel wiring. Home's green went from 65% (after the yard's new lamp) to 59.8%.

No note was declined outright. I bent one: the yard stays full width under both columns instead of moving to the right column, because with the kids' wishes moved out the left column would become the hole. I took the critic's other option instead, compact stops ending at the buffer.
crit: Home, Around the house (.yard / .yard-line / .ys): it is the sparsest thing on the page. Four stops are spread across 1120px with about 270px of bare steel between them. Each name sits on one line and its count on another below it, not on one baseline as briefed, and every .ys-name is underlined at rest; the lessons already counted row titles underlined at rest as a fault. Fix it this way. Put the name and its count on one baseline (.ys-name then .ys-say inline, the count in tabular DM Mono ink-2, drop text-decoration at rest and underline only on :hover/:focus-visible). Make the whole <li> the 44px target, with the ring and icon inside the link, instead of a short anchor. Either set the stops at a fixed pitch (about 14rem) so the line ends in its buffer a short way across, or give the yard the right column's lower half as briefed. Give the yard one lamp: the next setup stop on the Settings ring lit #6dff9c, and the amber half lamp only while something needs a look.

Home, the duplicated setup signal: the 'Finish setting up 1-2-3' strip and the yard's 'Settings 3 to finish' stop say the same thing about 450px apart. Fold the setup strip into the yard. The Settings stop carries '3 to finish', with the next step's words ('Choose your own password') in the .ys-say line and its ring lit as the next stop. Delete the standalone .setup row and its seam. That also takes back about 90px of the Home length the critique flagged (1670 against 1450).

Home title: 'What should Vera plan?' is a question form the round-14a lessons retired ('What's the/our plan?'). They asked for 'Tell Vera what to plan.' on Trued, which four notes preferred. Set it on one line with 'plan' keeping the E1 halo and the full stop inside the lit run (the setting Manual was credited for). The phone then breaks it as 'Tell Vera / what to plan.' with no orphan.

Phone, the Coming up rule head (.section-head.rule-head at <40rem): 'All plans →' and the T buffer wrap onto a separate line, so the buffer floats below and to the right of the rule, and '4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00' drops under without the head's indent. At <40rem, give the rule head a two-row grid: the head, rule and buffer on row 1, and the count line on row 2 aligned to the h2's left edge. Hide the rule's tail segment between the link and the buffer, so the link sits inside the buffer as on desktop. Do the same on Status's 'Keys … Change a key →' head, which shows the same stray gap-then-stub before the buffer at 1280 too.

The boxes are not carried through every page. Ideas' filter bar (.filters / the slate panel round Search, Kind, Status, For) and the New idea form (.form-panel round the field rail) both keep the slate frame the brief removed everywhere except the greeting board and the tubes. Unbox them onto the page ground. On Ideas, set the filters under a rule head 'Find' with a seam under them. On the form, the existing ring-stop field rail becomes the floor, with an engraved seam above the Add it / Cancel row. The form's rings are labelled by their fields and sit beside them, so they read as the line's stops rather than radios, which is the corrected form the lessons asked for.

Status foot (.status-foot, on every page): the three steel leaders run about 210px, 210px and 220px and read as the long empty strips the lessons limit to one per site. Make the leaders fixed and short (2.5rem each) and justify the row left: lamp, Ready, model, spend. Push only 'Status →' and the buffer to the right edge, so one rule runs to the buffer. Drop the underline from 'Status' at rest. While idle, the lamp should be the steel ring or the amber half lamp, as briefed; a static #6dff9c dot at rest spends the motif colour on nothing live.

Home plates, the drive fact (the drive line in the plate's foot): the leading steel em dash in '— 2 h 05 min NE' reads as a minus or a bullet. Replace it with the line's own glyph, a 10px steel route mark (the terminus bar turned sideways, or icon('route') at 12px), and set the figures as Ideas does: tabular DM Mono with the hour and minute numerals at ink weight and the units in ink-2, so '2 h 05 min' scans like the Ideas Drive column. Also, the third plate's right edge stops about 35px short of the rail's buffer. Align the last plate's right edge with the buffer, or centre each plate on its leader, so the plate row and the rail end together.

Settings > General (sticky .save-bar): the bar is translucent, and the next group's text ('This page') shows through it under 'An empty box uses the default it shows.' Give it a solid var(--surface) fill, an engraved-seam top edge (1px #20272b over rgba(255,255,255,.03)) and margin-bottom on the last group, so nothing passes underneath. Also, on Plans month the Earlier/Later buttons break the rule head's steel rule and leave a lone buffer stub after them. Move them inside the head row before the buffer, as the 'All plans →' link sits, so the rule runs unbroken to them.
